definition: a long narrow piece of something
description: A woman in a bright headscarf and a floral apron sits on a sunny terrace with a big patterned bowl of apples and potatoes on her lap. She turns a red apple against a small knife so that the skin comes away in one continuous ribbon rather than in pieces. The red and white ribbon gets longer and longer, curling over the edge of the bowl and hanging down past her knees towards the floor while she keeps turning the apple. She looks at the camera with her eyes and mouth wide open at how long the unbroken ribbon has become. Behind her are terracotta roof tiles, red geraniums in pots and washing on a line.

de.answer: Sie schält einen Apfel in einem einzigen langen Streifen.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?
